title: My reports
searchPlaceholderPro: Search by reference, species, location, organization, notes…
trashNote: Items in Trash stay here until you delete them permanently. Restoring puts them back where they were.
deleteBody: This removes {{ref}} and all of its timeline history, observations, corrections and attached photos from this device. This cannot be undone.
deleteBackupHint: Consider exporting a backup first (Settings → Storage & backups) if you might need this record later.
nothingMatchesHint: Try different search terms or filters.
updateNotePlaceholder: Describe the update in your own words…
updateSaved: Report updated — added to the timeline
correctionField_locationDescription_help: Describe the place so someone else could find it without asking you.
correctionField_locationDescription_plac: e.g. North bank of the river, below the footbridge
correctionField_locationDescription_reas: e.g. Visited the site again and can describe the spot more precisely.
correctionField_locationDescription_priv: Location details can identify places people care about — share only what responders need.
correctionField_species_help: Species stays 'unconfirmed — as reported' unless a professional confirms it.
correctionField_species_reasonExample: e.g. Identified from a clear photo by a rehabilitator.
correctionField_description_help: What the animal looks like — size, color, visible condition. Observations, not diagnosis.
correctionField_description_placeholder: e.g. Juvenile rabbit, brown, injured left hind leg
correctionField_description_reasonExampl: e.g. Closer look from a safe distance showed more detail.
correctionField_summary_help: One clear sentence about what happened. Corrections keep the original on the timeline.
correctionField_summary_placeholder: e.g. Found a grounded fledgling near the path; parents not seen for an hour
correctionField_summary_reasonExample: e.g. First summary was written in a hurry at the scene.
correctionField_nextStep_help: The single most useful thing to do next.
correctionField_nextStep_placeholder: e.g. Await callback from Riverside Wildlife Rescue
correctionField_nextStep_reasonExample: e.g. The rehabilitator confirmed a different drop-off time.
